pet_notes: Miniature chibi interpretation of the attached Gundam Wing Aries mobile suit. Match its steel/slate blue armor, off-white pale gray twin tall rectangular shoulder turbine housings with deep dark intake mouths, vivid cyan single visor, angular helmet, compact wing extensions, pale gray side armor, dark navy rifle and feet. Symmetrical grounded design for consistent animated sprites. Ignore the reference image black silhouette backdrop and white canvas. No olive green, orange visor, cream helmet, horns, or generic animal features.
